slate_note: This record reflects the Delaware Department of Elections certified candidate list, updated July 14, 2026, after the major-party filing deadline closed at noon that day. Whalen III is registered with the Federal Election Commission for this race but does not appear on the Delaware certified candidate list.

office.name: U.S. House of Representatives, Delaware At-Large
office.what_it_does: Delaware's single member of the U.S. House of Representatives, elected statewide to represent the entire state.

filing.ballot_label: On the Delaware ballot — Qualified. Filed June 12, 2026.

biography.fact: U.S. Representative for Delaware's at-large district, the state's sole member of the U.S. House. Took office January 3, 2025.
Delaware State Senator, First State Senate District, from 2020 to 2025.

roll_calls.title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
roll_calls.question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment

positions.quote: Today's decision is a win for upholding the Constitution and the ideals that have long shaped our nation. It firmly rejects the president's attempt to chip away at citizenship through exception after exception. Birthright citizenship is a cornerstone of our nation's civil liberties, and this decision further solidifies its validity.
